comparison.objective: Restock a shelf lane while preserving older red stock at the front; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Shelf extraction/reordering and placement versus recessed hex-key use, fine collar adjustment, counterholding, and controlled tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Blue stock must be added while red older stock ends in front; candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and a stable setting. No detailed restocking rubric/spec is available.
comparison.reason: Inventory rotation tests ordering and placement, not commissioning of an energy-absorbing mechanism.
